'''P'lia Orkina''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and officer of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] P'lia Orkina commanded a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="SWG:AotSS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Orkina and his wingmen assaulted the [[Tatooine Space Station]] and defeated the space forces of the [[Mos Eisley Police Authority]], demonstrating the domination of the Hutts over the Tatoo system.<ref name="SWG:AotSS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempHutt.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of P'lia Orkina]]
P'lia Orkina appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AotSS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> P'lia Orkina was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AotSS" />
